trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Tumkur, M.C.No.205/2014
facts_of_case: The parties are Smt. Kamalarathna and D. Shankaralingappa. The trial court allowed the petition filed under Section 13 (1) (i-a)(i-b) of the Hindu Marriage Act read with Section 25 of the Hindu Marriage Act and Section 7(c) of the Family Courts Act for divorce.

legal_principles.principle: A petition for divorce under Section 13(1)(i-a)(i-b) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, can be allowed if the petitioner proves that the respondent has been guilty of cruelty.
legal_principles.held: It is held that a petition for divorce under Section 13(1)(i-a)(i-b) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, can be allowed if the petitioner proves that the respondent has been guilty of cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the petitioner to prove that the respondent has been guilty of cruelty.
legal_principles.held: The burden lies on the petitioner to prove that the respondent has been guilty of cruelty.

outcome.final_order: The appeal was dismissed as not pressed.
